2608.26372.title: Knowledge-Verified Emergent Deception in LLM Agents Under Conflicting Incentives
2608.26372.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents serving users on behalf of companies, placing them in settings where user and deployer interests can conflict. When an agent knows that a user is owed something its deployer would prefer to deny, does it remain honest? Answering this is difficult because false statements can reflect either ignorance or hallucination rather than deception. To address this challenge, we introduce KnownLieBench , a knowledge-verified benchmark that first confirms through a neutral probe that an agent knows a user's entitlement, and then evaluates whether it makes false claims once an incentive to deny that entitlement is introduced. Specifically, KnownLieBench covers eight customer-service domains and 112 grounded cases, conducts multi-round dialogues with a trust-tracking customer agent, and separates deception emerging from incentive alone from deception produced under explicit instruction. Across eighteen proprietary and open-weight models, emergent deception varies substantially across model families and domains. We further use the benchmark for post-training, finding that honesty-directed fine-tuning reduces deception under incentive, while deception-graded fine-tuning increases lie success on honest-control dialogues without increasing lie frequency under incentive. By verifying entitlement knowledge before scoring deceptive behavior, KnownLieBench reduces the confound between lying and not knowing and enables more rigorous auditing and steering of agent honesty.
2608.26372.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地被部署為自主代理，代表公司為用戶提供服務，這使它們置身於用戶和部署者利益可能發生衝突的環境中。當一個代理知道用戶應得某些其部署者希望拒絕的東西時，它會保持誠實嗎？回答這個問題很困難，因為虛假陳述可能反映無知或幻覺，而非欺騙。為了解決這一挑戰，我們引入了 KnownLieBench，一個知識驗證基準，首先通過中立探測確認代理知道用戶的權益，然後評估在引入拒絕該權益的動機後，是否會做出虛假聲明。具體而言，KnownLieBench 涵蓋八個客戶服務領域和112個具體案例，與一個信任追蹤的客戶代理進行多輪對話，並將僅由動機產生的欺騙與在明確指令下產生的欺騙區分開來。在十八個專有和開放權重模型中，出現的欺騙在模型家族和領域之間差異顯著。我們進一步利用該基準進行後訓練，發現以誠實為導向的微調在動機下減少了欺騙，而以欺騙為評級的微調則在誠實控制對話中增加了謊言成功率，同時在動機下不增加謊言頻率。通過在評分欺騙行為之前驗證權益知識，KnownLieBench 減少了欺騙與無知之間的混淆，並使代理誠實的審計和引導更加嚴謹。
